description: Government announces £100 million in initial funding for an expert Foundation Model Taskforce, the institute's documented predecessor.
short: Foundation Model Taskforce announced with £100 million initial funding.

description: The taskforce's first progress report announces that, from that day, it is renamed the Frontier AI Taskforce.
short: Taskforce renamed the Frontier AI Taskforce.

description: Earliest identified institutionally credited output: Frontier AI Taskforce: first progress report
short: First published work credited to the institute.

description: Prime Minister announces the UK will establish the world's first AI Safety Institute to evaluate and test new AI models.
short: Prime Minister announces plans to establish an AI Safety Institute.

description: AI Safety Institute launched; the Frontier AI Taskforce becomes the institute, tasked with testing frontier AI before and after release.
short: Frontier AI Taskforce becomes the AI Safety Institute.

description: Institute starts work at launch, building on the taskforce's team.
short: Institute starts work, building on the taskforce's team.

description: The government renames the AI Safety Institute the AI Security Institute and announces a criminal misuse team; its release says the institute will not focus on bias or freedom of speech, and the minister says its work will not change.
short: Government renames the institute and announces a criminal misuse team.

description: Government announces the creation of INESIA, federating ANSSI, Inria, LNE and PEReN under SGDSN and DGE steering, without a new legal structure.
short: Government announces INESIA, bringing existing bodies together without a new legal structure.

description: Minister announces the launch of the institute.
short: Minister announces the institute's launch.

description: Earliest identified institutionally credited output: Improving Methodologies for LLM Evaluations Across Global Languages
short: First published work credited to the institute.

description: National Security Council decides to found an AI security institute to pool capacity for analysing advanced AI models and their risks.
short: National Security Council decides to found an AI security institute.

description: Digital and interior ministries set up AISI Deutschland in Berlin, phase 1 as a virtual core in BSI and BNetzA, implementing the council's decision.
short: Ministries establish AISI Deutschland, initially within BSI and BNetzA.

description: AISI Deutschland starts work.
short: AISI Deutschland starts work.

description: Prime Minister presents the IA360 plan; measure 4: Spain will set up an AI Security Institute inside AESIA to evaluate the most advanced models before and after deployment.
short: Government AI plan commits to an AI Security Institute within AESIA.

description: The 2027 budget proposes extending KI Norge's mandate to AI safety and NOK 45.1m for KI Norge, including a NOK 30m increase to strengthen this work, with model evaluation alongside research institutions. It separately names KI Norge as the contact point for international safety communities, including AI Safety Institutes.
short: Budget proposes NOK 45.1m and an AI safety mandate for KI Norge.

description: Written answer reports an interdepartmental exploration by the Digitale Doetank into an independent AI safety institute, modelled on the UK institute, running until September 2026.
short: Cabinet confirms an interdepartmental exploration of an independent AI safety institute.

description: Study of the option, commissioned by the economy ministry from TNO, published; exploration under way by this date
short: Ministry-commissioned TNO study of an AI safety institute option is published.

description: International AI Strategy reaffirms exploration of the desirability and feasibility of a Dutch AI safety institute, taking account of existing advisory bodies.
short: International AI Strategy reaffirms exploration of a Dutch AI safety institute.

description: Cabinet letter to parliament: an exploration of an AI safety institute is under way; the advisory report will be shared with parliament by the end of 2026.
short: Cabinet says AI safety institute exploration under way; report due year end.

description: The government-appointed AI Commission publishes an advisory recommendation to establish a Swedish AI safety institute able to host a testing laboratory.
short: Advisory recommendation for a Swedish AI safety institute.

description: The Commission adopts its decision to establish the European AI Office within the Commission; the decision will enter into force on 21 February 2024.
short: Commission adopts decision to establish the European AI Office.

description: Commission Decision of 24 January 2024 establishing the European AI Office, tasked among other things with tools and benchmarks for evaluating general-purpose AI models, enters into force.
short: Decision establishing the European AI Office enters into force.

description: The AI Office organisational structure, including the AI Safety unit for systemic-risk identification and evaluation/testing approaches, takes effect.
short: AI Office organisational structure, including its AI Safety unit, takes effect.

description: Earliest identified institutionally credited output: Improving Methodologies for Agentic Evaluations Across Domains: Leakage of Sensitive Information, Fraud and Cybersecurity Threats
short: First published work credited to the institute.

description: Commerce Department announces it will establish the US AI Safety Institute at NIST, including for evaluating the most advanced models.
short: Commerce announces plans to establish the US AI Safety Institute at NIST.

description: NIST states the US AI Safety Institute was established under NIST; inaugural director named.
short: NIST confirms institute established under NIST; inaugural director named.

description: Earliest identified institutionally credited output: The United States Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute: Vision, Mission, and Strategic Goals
short: First published work credited to the institute.

description: Commerce announces reform of the U.S. AI Safety Institute as CAISI, directing voluntary industry collaboration and evaluations focused on national-security risks, including cybersecurity, biosecurity and chemical weapons.
short: Commerce announces institute reform as CAISI, focusing evaluations on national security risks.

description: The institute, until then the Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI), is renamed the Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence (CAISSI). NIST's super intelligence page uses the new name in the earliest archived capture found, dated 30 September 2026. The page says NIST is updating its communications under the Executive Order of 29 September 2026. NIST's release of 16 October 2026 also uses the name. No published act gives the date of the change.
short: Renamed Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence (CAISSI).
source_ids: us-si-page-archive-2026-09-30; us-caissi-archive-2026-10-03; depth-us-incident-release; us-caissi; us-si-page; us-commerce-2025

description: Budget 2024 proposes CAD 50m over five years to create an AI Safety Institute of Canada.
short: Budget proposes CAD 50m over five years to create the institute.

description: Minister of Innovation, Science and Industry launches the Canadian AI Safety Institute within the industry department.
short: Minister launches Canadian AI Safety Institute within the industry department.

description: Public launch of the institute in Montreal.
short: Institute publicly launches in Montreal.

description: Earliest identified institutionally credited output: Improving Methodologies for LLM Evaluations Across Global Languages
short: First published work credited to the institute.

description: Prime Minister Kishida tells the AI Strategy Council the government will set up an AI Safety Institute, aiming for January 2024.
short: Prime Minister announces AI Safety Institute plans, aiming for January 2024.

description: The Cabinet Office announces that the AI Safety Institute has been established within IPA as a body to study AI safety evaluation methods, with a director in office.
short: Cabinet Office announces institute established within IPA, with a director.

description: IPA announces that AISI has begun with an appointed director and an IPA secretariat to research AI safety evaluation methods.
short: IPA announces institute has begun, to research AI safety evaluation methods.

description: Earliest identified institutionally credited output: Crosswalk 1: NIST AI Risk Management Framework and Japan AI Guidelines for Business
short: First published work credited to the institute.

description: Science minister Lee Jong-ho says Korea will set up an AI Safety Institute inside ETRI within the year.
short: Minister commits to an AI Safety Institute inside ETRI within the year.

description: The science ministry opens the AI Safety Institute inside ETRI after preparing its organisation, budget and staff.
short: Science ministry opens AI Safety Institute inside ETRI.

description: The institute is officially launched within ETRI.
short: Institute officially launches within ETRI.

description: Earliest identified institutionally credited output: Improving Methodologies for LLM Evaluations Across Global Languages
short: First published work credited to the institute.

description: The AI Basic Act enters into force; Article 12 lets the science minister run the AI Safety Institute, with risk analysis and safety evaluation research among its tasks.
short: AI Basic Act takes effect, authorising the minister to run the institute.

description: The Digital Trust Centre at NTU is designated as Singapore's AI Safety Institute.
short: Digital Trust Centre designated as Singapore's AI Safety Institute.

description: Earliest identified institutionally credited output: A Pilot Testing Exercise from the International Network of AI Safety Institutes
short: First published work credited to the institute.

description: The industry minister announces the government is establishing an Australian AI Safety Institute to evaluate emerging AI capabilities.
short: Minister announces government is establishing an institute to evaluate emerging AI capabilities.

description: The National AI Plan commits A$29.9 million to establish the institute in early 2026.
short: National AI Plan commits A$29.9 million to establish institute in early 2026.

description: The industry department describes the institute as part of the department, with a remit to analyse and test new AI models; no dated founding act found.
short: Department describes institute as part of it; no dated founding act found.

description: The industry department formally launches the institute; the next day the assistant minister says it is operational.
short: Department formally launches the institute.

description: Earliest identified institutionally credited output: Best Practice: Automated Evaluation of Large Language Models
short: First published work credited to the institute.

description: The Ministry of Digital states that Malaysia has established the Malaysia AI Safety Institute, covering safety evaluations, testing and red teaming.
short: Ministry confirms Malaysia AI Safety Institute established.

description: Cabinet Resolution 75 adopts the national AI strategy, which plans INC with an AI-security specialisation including monitoring attacks on national AI models. This is a related-body commitment, without a qualifying evaluation remit. The date records adoption, not institute creation or commencement.
short: Cabinet adopts strategy planning a cybersecurity institute with AI-security specialisation.

description: The January announcement describes an institute being set up; the November India AI Governance Guidelines call it recently established. These sources bound establishment to 2025; the exact founding date is not verified.
short: Guidelines describe institute as recently established; exact founding date remains unverified.

description: The IT minister announces the setting up of the IndiaAI Safety Institute under the IndiaAI Mission, on a hub-and-spoke model.
short: Minister announces IndiaAI Safety Institute is being set up, using hub-and-spoke model.

description: An expression of interest invites partner institutions to join the IndiaAI Safety Institute.
short: Partner institutions invited to join the IndiaAI Safety Institute.

description: National AI Strategy 2025-2030 launched; flagship project 5.2.3 is to develop a national AI risk and safety institute.
short: National AI Strategy commits to developing an AI risk and safety institute.

description: Strategy implementation roadmap lists establishing a National AI Risk and Safety Institute.
short: Strategy roadmap lists establishing a National AI Risk and Safety Institute.

description: Earliest identified institutionally credited output: Improving Methodologies for LLM Evaluations Across Global Languages
short: First published work credited to the institute.

description: Draft AI policy put out for comment would establish the Kenya AI Safety Institute for testing, evaluation and red-teaming.
short: Draft policy proposes Kenya AI Safety Institute; consultation opens.
